title: HELIX Terminology: Position Status
description: Status of a funded position in the institutional position management system.

codes.definition: Position is authorized and funded but currently vacant. Available for recruitment or internal transfer.
Position is occupied by an active worker. One position may map to multiple workers if job-shared.
Position exists in the system but hiring is suspended, typically due to budget constraints or hiring freeze. The position's budget may be temporarily redirected.
Position has been permanently eliminated. Budget line removed. Cannot be filled without re-creation through position management approval process.
New position request submitted but not yet approved through governance process. Awaiting budget approval, classification review, and/or provost/VP authorization.
Position used for temporary or student worker appointments where multiple individuals can be appointed against the same position number. Common for adjunct pools, student worker pools.
